name: Frost Pill
summary: A floating frosted-glass tab bar with a springy lens and a sun and moon theme switch
about: A floating tab bar made of frosted glass that blurs and tints the colourful scene behind it. A brighter glass lens springs to the selected tab and stretches while it moves, the glass tips toward your pointer and catches the light, and a round switch turns the sun into a moon with a burst of stars while the scene fades from day to night. Good for switching sections in an app or a settings page.
how: Move the mouse over the bar: the glass leans toward the pointer and a soft highlight follows it.
Click or tap a tab, or use the Left and Right arrow keys: the lens springs over, stretching with speed, and the icon plays its own little move.
The cards above swap and rise in one after another with a slight 3D flip.
Press the sun button: rays spin away, a bite slides over it to make a moon, stars burst out and the scene turns to night. The page starts in your system theme, or in ?theme=light or ?theme=dark.
